hero.headline: Total Sovereignty. Zero Friction.
hero.description: DevOpsHub is an open-source, self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service. Paste your GitHub URL, click Deploy, and let our 9-stage pipeline build your Docker image and stream real-time logs directly to your browser—all on your own infrastructure.
hero.trustStatement: Runs on AWS Free Tier. Open Source. Self-Hosted.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.description: Deploying web applications to cloud servers is complex and manual. Existing solutions are insufficient.
points: Manual SSH, git clone, and docker build for every deployment.
No visibility into what's happening on the server.
Expensive proprietary PaaS platforms like Heroku charging per dyno.
Complex Nginx reverse-proxy configurations for every application.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.description: DevOpsHub automates every single step from a simple web dashboard. Think of it as hiring an automated kitchen manager who does everything for you the moment new code arrives—and sends you live updates on your dashboard.

whyChooseUs.title: Zero-Cost
whyChooseUs.description: Optimized to run on t2.micro or t3.micro (AWS Free Tier) without paying $7+/dyno/month.

whyChooseUs.title: Total Sovereignty
whyChooseUs.description: Deploy on your AWS EC2 instance. You own the infrastructure and your database records.

whyChooseUs.title: Secure By Default
whyChooseUs.description: Built-in AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets, JWT authentication, and rate limiting.

features.title: One-Click Deployment
features.description: Select a project, click Deploy, and the 9-stage pipeline runs automatically.

features.title: Real-Time Log Streaming
features.description: Live build and deploy logs streamed directly to the browser via Socket.io WebSockets.

features.title: Auto Framework Detection
features.description: Automatically detects static sites, Node.js apps, or Docker Compose projects and generates the appropriate configuration.

features.title: Self-Healing Mechanisms
features.description: Automatic port conflict resolution, disk space cleanup, and corrupted clone recovery.

features.title: Server Monitoring
features.description: CPU and RAM utilization charts ready for Grafana.

aboutUs.title: Built for Builders
aboutUs.description: DevOpsHub was conceived to solve a real problem: students, freelancers, and small dev teams needed an affordable, self-hosted alternative to expensive proprietary PaaS solutions.

howItWorks.title: Configure Server
howItWorks.description: Save your target EC2 server with its IP and encrypted PEM private key.

howItWorks.title: One-Click Deploy
howItWorks.description: Click deploy, and DevOpsHub automatically SSHs into your server.

howItWorks.title: Real-Time Build
howItWorks.description: The 9-stage pipeline clones, builds a Docker image, and starts the container.

howItWorks.title: Go Live
howItWorks.description: Get a live URL instantly with real-time logs.

benefits.title: Automated Containerization
benefits.description: Generates robust Docker configurations automatically, stripping away the friction of manual DevOps.

benefits.title: Uncompromising Privacy
benefits.description: You own the infrastructure, the access keys, and your database records.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: DevOpsHub is open-source and optimized to run on the AWS Free Tier, meaning $0/month for 12 months on a t3.micro.

faq.question: Do I need to know Docker?
faq.answer: No. The Auto Framework Detection automatically generates Docker configurations for static HTML and Node.js applications.

faq.question: Is my AWS data secure?
faq.answer: Yes. All sensitive data (GitHub token, AWS secret key, SSH private key) is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before database storage.

cta.headline: Take Control of Your Deployments
cta.description: Stop paying for proprietary platforms. Host your own PaaS today.
